lines.text: Many learners say: I want that you come.
Better: I want you to come.
To! I want you to help me.

native.tip: Im Englischen gibt es kein „want that“. Du sagst „I want you to come“.
native.caption: Du willst, dass jemand etwas tut? 💬 Falsch: “I want that you come.” Richtig: “I want you to come.” Hör Ama zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “to”. Richtig heißt es: “I want you to come.” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.hook: Do you want someone to do something?
en.tip: English has no “want that”. You say “I want you to come”.
en.caption: Do you want someone to do something? Wrong: “I want that you come.” Right: “I want you to come.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
